name: Set A
description: Your 9 questions plus 2 traps: the main scorecard. Two-part questions, section references and comparisons.
source: Build spec §7; answer pages verified by hand in ~/Dev/RAG/advanced-rag (LEARNING_LOG.md, M3-M4).

questions.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
questions.note: 166, in 25 states. The 3-year total of over 610 is a different number.

questions.question: What new digital system replaced FDsys, and when was it fully deployed?
questions.note: govinfo: out of beta Dec 2017, full-scale deployment during FY 2018, FDsys retired Dec 2018.

questions.question: How much did GPO procure in printing and information products in FY 2018 on behalf of federal agencies?
What is the growth outlook for South Asia in this report?
questions.note: 6.3% in 2026, then about 7% a year in 2027-28.

questions.question: What does Chapter 3 say about sovereign debt in developing economies?
questions.note: Rising debt leads to higher spreads and yields, a non-linear effect. The bibliography (p139-140) ranked above the summary in the baseline.

questions.question: According to the executive summary, what are the main risks to the global outlook?
questions.note: Renewed escalation of hostilities, commodity disruptions, inflation, food insecurity. The baseline misses it: the risks paragraph never says 'executive summary' (rank 45).

questions.question: How much less energy does iMac use compared to the ENERGY STAR requirement?
What is the total carbon footprint of the iMac, and how much of that comes from product use versus manufacturing?
What material is the iMac stand made from, and what percentage of it is recycled?
What is the capital of France?
questions.note: Trap: not in the documents, though every model knows it. Must refuse.

questions.question: What was GPO's net income in fiscal year 2019?
questions.note: Trap: the report covers FY 2018 only. Must refuse.
